GOOD TO KNOW

New starters get a course: the Academy assigns the New agent course to new agents, due in 14 days. It is on for every organisation, so agents added in the last 7 days get it too. Switch it off, or change the days, under Team and quality → Academy → Settings.

Custom roles: roles with their own list of screens do not see the Academy until it is added to that list under People and routing → Roles.

Refresh browsers after the update.

FOR AGENTS

The Academy: choose Academy at the foot of My work. Courses are made from the help guides, a lesson at a time, each with a short check of three questions. Pass every lesson's check and the course is yours, with a certificate beside your avatar under Me. Answers are explained after each try, and only your best score counts.

The bookshelf: choose Knowledge under My work to see the knowledge base as books on a shelf, a book for each category or one your supervisor arranged. A book opens to its articles as chapters; ticks show what you have read, and New or Changed ribbons show what arrived or changed since you last opened it. One search box highlights the books that match. On a call, a compact shelf sits in the Knowledge panel below the suggestions.

FOR SUPERVISORS AND ADMINISTRATORS

Team progress: Team and quality → Academy shows who has done which course, their scores and certificates, and what is overdue. Assign a course to people or whole teams with a due date; people, whoever assigned it and their team leaders are told once when it is overdue. Team leaders see and assign within the teams they lead.

Three courses: New agent, Supervisor and a new Administrator course, with 141 questions between them.

Points for learning: gamification has a new measure, Academy courses completed.

Arranging the bookshelf: under Customers → Knowledge base, switch to Bookshelf and choose Arrange books to make books of your own, with a cover colour and picture, and place articles in them. Articles you do not place go to the book for their first category.

FIXES

A category spelt two ways ("Billing" and "billing") is one book, named with its capital.

FOR PLATFORM OPERATORS

Testing now happens on staging: the test runner syncs to staging and runs beside its services, and the production server is no longer used for tests."}
